title: guajava costaricensis
intro: Guajava costaricensis, commonly known as Costa Rican Guava, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to Central America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote digestive health and alleviate symptoms of gastritis and ulcers due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Guajava costaricensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which make it useful for wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory treatments. The bioactive constituents of Guajava costaricensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
